independence: Does not import, call, edit or reproduce zapote-erc::pfc_switching, and does not edit or reuse the zapote-erc pfc_switching model. All numbers come from vendor device SPICE models run in ngspice. The testbench is the N-DPT attempt-001 ngspice clamped-inductive double-pulse bench, reused byte-for-byte (see testbench_reuse).

applied_operating_point.external_gate_r_model: behavioral resistor R = 5.3 + 4.4*u(V(drive)-6); switches at V(drive)=6 V
applied_operating_point.current_error_vs_requested_percent: turn-on +0.7 % (25 C) / +0.7 % (125 C); turn-off -0.15 % (25 C) / -0.42 % (125 C); measured event currents are reported per case rather than scaled.
applied_operating_point.note: Identical to N-DPT attempt-001. No STW65N65DM2AG case was run: the vendor model could not be captured.

IPW65R045C7.role: baseline control (C7), NOT the task device
IPW65R045C7.source: Infineon CoolMOS C7 650 V PSpice library (captured in N-DPT attempt-001; reused byte-identically)
IPW65R045C7.model_level: vendor Level-0 (nominal/typical device, no temperature terminal)
IPW65R045C7.temperature_binding: .temp 25 / .temp 125; only the vendor's resistor temperature coefficients respond

STW65N65DM2AG.family: MDmesh DM2, automotive-grade 650 V, 42 mOhm typ., 60 A, TO-247

testbench.topology: 400 V bus -> 180 uH boost inductor -> switching node sw -> 0 V sense element -> MOSFET drain, MOSFET source to ground; freewheel SiC diode sw->bus (anode sw, cathode bus)
testbench.gate_network: PWL 0->12 V drive through behavioral external resistor (9.7 ohm on / 5.3 ohm off); vendor intrinsic gate network (Rg=0.82 ohm, Lg=5 nH) retained inside the model
testbench.energy_integration: E = integral of v(drain)*i(Vsense) dt over the switching-transition window; integrator = ngspice `meas tran ... integ <vector>` on pv = v(drain)*i(vsense)
testbench.eoss_method: Coss(v) from a small-signal AC admittance sweep (100 kHz) at DC drain-bias points, Vgs=0; Eoss(400) = integral of v*Coss(v) dv (trapezoidal). This is the datasheet Coss(v) definition.
testbench.freewheel_diode: substitute Infineon IDH16G65C5_L3 (650 V / 16 A CoolSiC G5), same as N-DPT; retained part Wolfspeed C3D20065D was not capturable in N-DPT either.
